theorem_baselines.statement: The source records the inequality as clear for 2-regular graphs; the open range begins at degree 3.
The neighboring TxGraffiti inequality alpha(G) <= mu(G) for regular graphs is already proved and is not evidence for the saturation analogue.

this neighboring proved inequality calibrates notation but does not control the two minimum-saturation parameters

sign_potential.exact_expression: G is connected and every vertex has the same degree r>=3
sign_potential.rationale: every wall move is a degree-preserving two-switch and disconnected children are rejected
the wall arm preserves one explicit maximal matching, giving mu*(child)<=mu*(parent); exact optimization may lower it further
candidate switches are ranked by the number of parent minimum independent dominating sets they invalidate
the intended separation pins a small maximal matching while forcing independent domination upward
